description:
Three folios and an additional fragment from a literary work comparing the readings of Abū Saʿīd Aharon b. Moshe b. Asher and Abū ʿImrān Moshe b. David b. Naftali, collated by Levi b. al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī al-Baṣrī. Two pages of Arabic state documents were recycled for this; they seem to be from different documents but this is uncertain. Fol. 1 of the literary work also includes an Arabic name in the margin: Yaʿqūb b. Ismāʿīl b. Yaʿqūb b. [???]. Fol. 4 of the literary text has ownership notes, some crossed out. The legible ones include Yeshuʿa b. Daniʾel and Shemuʾel b. Avraham. 

The first Arabic page (fol. 3r) mentions Abū l-Faraj; the payment of an account; "and when I returned to al-Ramla, I found that he had arrived. . . . " The second page of Arabic (fol. 4r) shows pronounced stacking of words at the ends of lines and is difficult to read.
